title: Quality drastically down
text: Quality drastically down. I bought 4 sets of these a year ago.  They were really nice.  Thick good quality. Then I ordered 2 more sets and these are definitely not the same.  They are visibly see-through, thinner, and getting thinner by the moment.  Every time I wash them my lint trap it is completely full of black fuzz. And they now come with a tag... on every single napkin.  It took me half an hour to cut them all off and not worth the trouble.
